release.definition: The CTO powersuit is a set of agent skills, one module per CTO function from the deploy gate to the hand-over, that one person uses to run a company's whole engineering platform.

sections.title: An AI operating system for the CTO function

software.name: fit (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: The entry assessment: runs the sdlc audit and recommends which modules to fit and in which order. Its repo clinic audits a public repository at its owner's request, and its file-findings skill files a review's findings as GitHub Issues labelled by area, kind, and severity, with a scorecard per area.

software.name: decisions (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: RFCs, architecture decision records, and a review of the decision log, with a gate check that every record has a status, an owner, and a date.

software.name: direction (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: A weekly review of the tracker across all areas that writes a memo (what moved, what is blocked, the proposed allocation of the week, the decisions needed) and records each confirmed decision as a tracker item, with a gate check that every memo has a date, a period, its four sections, and a status on every decision.

software.name: sdlc (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: The software delivery lifecycle: an audit for repositories built without one, tickets, change review for agent-written code, a local CI run before each push, test strategy, and release with rollback.

software.name: gate (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: A deploy gate: rules with pass and fail fixtures, run records, findings that close only on a passing rerun, and a workflow whose deploy job waits for the gate and for the repository's own tests.

software.name: docs (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: A docs tree where every page has an owner and review dates, runbooks, a sweep for stale pages, and a static docs build.

software.name: reliability (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Availability targets, SLOs and error budgets, incidents and postmortems, a static status page, an on-call policy, a backup inventory with restore tests, and a change record on every server.

software.name: observability (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Alloy, Prometheus, Loki, Grafana, and Alertmanager with docker compose, dashboards as code, and alert routes.

software.name: finops (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: A cost baseline from invoices and billing exports, showback, unit costs, a SaaS stack audit, and a FOCUS export, with a gate check that every cost figure carries a period and a source.

software.name: security (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Supply chain, secrets, and access for a repository and its agents: actions pinned by commit SHA with an owner allowlist, a vulnerability scan and an SBOM, provenance checks for skills and MCP servers, pre-push hooks that refuse a secret or a private term, an inventory of admin entrances with their multi-factor method, and a quarantine for third-party text.

software.name: compliance (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: A control map to ISO 27001, TISAX, NIS2, and the GDPR by clause and article number, an AI Act triage, and a legal baseline for a website.

software.name: red-team (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Pressure tests for a team's AI features: scripted multi-turn runs in a world with a known right answer, graded on the decision the system took.

software.name: ai-ops (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Operations for a team's coding agents: a shared harness with narrow permissions, agent spend metered per API request with a budget alert, an audit trail of tool calls, and a coordinator pattern with state in files.

software.name: aieo (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Visibility in AI search: llms.txt, structured data, answer probes, and predictions hashed before a page goes live.

software.name: hiring (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: An interview loop, rubrics with anchored levels, debriefs with evidence before votes, and the profile of the person who takes over the platform.

software.name: handover (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Hand the platform to its owner: training per module, exit criteria, and a test plan that shows the owner runs the platform from the docs alone.

software.name: vestige (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: An output filter you calibrate to yourself from your own transcripts. Hooks scan every reply and every Markdown file Claude writes.

software.name: vault (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: A plain-Markdown vault with hybrid keyword and semantic search, served to Claude as an MCP server, with skills to seed it and to atomize documents into it.

software.name: stance (CTO powersuit plugin)
software.description: Stance filters: professional-b2, good-chad, receipts, poles, and mode-leak.
